lore.short: Innocent princess that grew up in the Swan Castle and genius mage that excels in sword and scepter.

skills.name: Lakeshore Ambience
skills.description:
For 8s after casting a skill, Odette's next Basic Attack gains extra range and bounces between enemies (or an enemy and herself), dealing 144-200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per hit.

Odette's skills also trigger this effect on hit (up to 3 stacks).

skills.name: Avian Authority
skills.description: Odette releases a magic swan in the target direction, dealing 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

skills.name: Blue Nova
skills.description: Odette releases magic energy balls in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.5s. Upon hit, an energy ball splits off to attack a nearby enemy (prioritizes enemy heroes), dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

skills.name: Swan Song
skills.description:
Odette channels a dance, gaining a 1200 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and dealing up to 2000 (+750% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies in a large area for 5s. During this time, her Movement Speed is reduced by 40%, but she can move freely.

Use again to cancel. Only high-level control effects can interrupt this skill.

assist.desc: Pair Odette with heroes who can relocate their teammates like Johnson and Jawhead to make it easier for her to find the perfect position for her Ultimate.

strong.desc: Odette's Ultimate is capable of unleashing massive damage and is effective against heroes lacking interruption skills, such as Layla and Irithel.

weak.desc: Odette is countered by heroes with Crowd Control skills, such as Minotaur and Edith, because they can easily interrupt her Ultimate.
